v41_close_inventory.description: CYCLE-005 D18, REQ-202, REQ-205. Cues the person to open their inventory, then five seconds later asks their own client to close it. Expect CLIENT_ACTION requested on the server, then on the client result=done with the inventory's class as screen and showing=none, then reported done.
commands: devtool checkpoint cue OPEN_INVENTORY_NOW title sound

v41_close_nothing.description: REQ-205. Close with no screen open: the server sends it, the client refuses with reason=noScreen, and the server writes the report.

v41_respawn_alive.description: REQ-204, CYC5-005. A respawn asked of a living player fails at once on the server with devtool.client.notDead, tolerated here; nothing is sent to the client.

v41_death_close_respawn.description: REQ-204, REQ-205. Kills the caller, then asks for a close on the death screen (refused deathScreenUseRespawn), then a respawn (done once the death screen has been up 20 ticks). keepInventory is set first so nothing drops. The respawn is the last step: the bundle's caller is the player who died.

v41_kill.description: B14. Kills the caller with keepInventory on, so the next inbox request can be client respawn.
